study_role: fixed-size paired diagnostic; conditional on reused real covariates; not external validation

intervention.broad: first 80 rows of random history reservoir
intervention.gap: 80 lowest transformed feature-1 rows within same 240-row reservoir; tie break reservoir index
intervention.shared: same X, p, labels, O/C/Q/T, preprocessing, empirical q, numerical B, anchor and family across arms
intervention.preprocessing: fit only once on broad reference history; no intervention-dependent refit; tau_aux=0
intervention.risk_and_family: computed only once using broad reference history, without O, then frozen for both arms
intervention.interpretation: fixed reference decision problem; does not estimate full end-to-end pipeline effect with q and family re-estimated

selection.CRN: same base normal draws across arms; arm-specific Laplace transform
selection.scope: common-family rescoring, not unchanged package DC-PRISM

primary_metric: known-p expected Brier on fixed test covariates after O and S settle
headroom: anchor expected Brier minus minimum family expected Brier; realized training labels, offline oracle
gain: anchor expected Brier minus policy expected Brier
inference: paired world-level t, global Holm p-values and Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals; normal approximation; four datasets/DGP cells not four institutions
stopping: 64 pairs per cell fixed before formal execution; no interim statistical looks, no outcome-dependent additions
optimizer_acceptance: record every optimizer call; all fits must report success
limitations: same source real X reused across simulations
post-settlement single-state diagnostic is not delayed online ten-round ALC
oracle uses hidden training outcomes after selections are locked and is not deployable
large-pool reference cardinality/risk solver is bounded/heuristic
historical gap is an intervention on distribution at fixed sample count; not a unique natural transfer mechanism
broad reference preprocessing and risk model are held fixed; gap arm is not trained exclusively from gap history for these nuisance components
